notes: INSIDE half of the Sporeling Rot Pod: the pod cradle with a feed root to the right (the ammo rack sits beside it), power coupling, repair hatch and five spore sacs. charge: a rot pod rolls in from the root into the cradle (frame 5 = seated and ready); fire: the cradle is empty. damaged: root cracked, sacs withered; disabled: a pod stuck half-way in the root. Barrel layer sporeling_rot_pod_barrel: a cradle of two curved fingers holding a violet rot pod; fire: the pod leaves, a spore puff follows. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
